release.full_package_tests_conclusion: success: Go/race and six distribution lifecycle jobs

behavior: Source refresh and candidate checks each default to enabled/60 minutes, minimum 30 minutes, independently configurable or disabled
Completion-based due times persist across restart; simultaneous due jobs refresh first; source failure keeps the prior candidate pool
Python Builder lock and shared due record deduplicate manager/systemd source acquisition; disabled or not-yet-due scheduled work does not fetch
Explicit web and CLI refresh bypass automatic interval/off setting but keep the same build lock and update the completion clock
Candidate batch checks reuse configured concurrency and manual priority without overlapping full batches; running exits keep their independent health checks
Clash/Mihomo complete profiles generated on the owner VPS; original Base64 default, authentication, source selection, naming, order and ready-state filtering retained
No third-party subscription converter, DIRECT failover or insecure TLS setting; unsupported transports explicitly refused

lifecycle: Empty-source installation and authenticated management with direct subscription HTTPS
Custom automation switches and intervals retained through updates, along with management/subscription identity
Real systemd timer skips source acquisition when automatic refresh is disabled; explicit CLI refresh still acquires a controlled HTTPS pool
Candidate recovery automatically creates/binds 16 unverified exits without submitting target settings; synthetic VPN destination locally rejected
Existing Slot identities and explicit zero/disabled direct intent survive updates
Complete uninstall removes project state while preserving unrelated resources and shared dependencies

mihomo.configuration_acceptance: passed for generated REALITY, TLS WebSocket, Trojan gRPC and VMess profiles
mihomo.new_install: passed: actual VLESS/REALITY HTTPS egress equality and example content
mihomo.after_update: passed: repeated same actual subscription chain
mihomo.failure: passed: selected server unavailable causes request failure, not DIRECT fallback

retained_failed_rounds.finding: First actual Mihomo request failed after static config acceptance. Root network cause was not determined; subsequent tests first establish the Xray control, include sanitized diagnostics and verify the same strict chain on installation and update. No exporter security relaxation.
A prior test helper observed done before new completion persistence finished, causing TempDir cleanup races; wait for the finished channel and fixture shutdown.
Race-suite repeat confirmed the same fixture-cleanup ordering issue; fixed without suppressing assertions.
New legacy timer test used the wrong old description; corrected to the exact shipped signature, preserving strict ownership checks.

limitations: Clash Verge GUI version was not supplied; tested the official Mihomo core, not every old GUI release
Controlled candidate fixtures do not establish current real VPN Gate positive connectivity or guarantee ready exit count/country
Seven opt-in live/environment-specific Go tests skipped; no production VPS access or deployment in this round
Container validation shares the runner kernel and does not replace independent VPS SELinux/firewalld/provider-network validation
Superseded duplicate push/PR workflows were cancelled to release runner capacity; final branch and formal package workflows completed successfully
